title: Mechanism of sulforaphane in treatment of pancreatic cancer cell based on network pharmacology and in vitro experiments.
authors: Ren, Ziyi; Feng, Jiahui; Yang, Meng; Feng, Danqi; Wang, Xianghong; Liu, Weihua
one_liner_zh: 该文基于网络药理学和体外实验研究莱菔硫烷对胰腺癌的作用机制，虽含分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Sulforaphane (SFN), a bioactive compound derived from cruciferous vegetables, exhibits anti-cancer properties, though its role in pancreatic cancer is poorly understood. Network pharmacology and molecular docking (computer-simulated) identified the p53 pathway as a potential SFN target. In vitro experiments demonstrated that SFN suppressed PANC-1 cell proliferation and metastasis, induced G2/M arrest, and promoted apoptosis. Western blot analysis revealed SFN-mediated downregulation of cyclin B1 and CDK1 (linked to cycle arrest), upregulation of E-cadherin, and suppression of MMP-9 (impeding invasion). SFN also modulated apoptosis markers (Caspase-3/9 activation, Bax/Bcl-2 imbalance) and activated the p53 pathway (elevated p-p53, p53, p21, and GADD45A). These results underscore SFN's therapeutic potential against pancreatic cancer via p53 signaling.
abstract_zh: 莱菔硫烷（Sulforaphane, SFN）是一种源自十字花科蔬菜的生物活性化合物，具有抗癌特性，但其在胰腺癌中的作用尚不明确。通过网络药理学和分子对接（计算机模拟）技术，鉴定出p53通路为SFN的潜在靶点。体外实验表明，SFN抑制了PANC-1细胞的增殖和转移，诱导G2/M期阻滞，并促进细胞凋亡。Western blot分析显示，SFN介导了细胞周期蛋白B1和CDK1的下调（与周期阻滞相关），上调E-钙粘蛋白，并抑制MMP-9（阻碍侵袭）。SFN还调节了凋亡标志物（Caspase-3/9激活，Bax/Bcl-2失衡）并激活p53通路（p-p53、p53、p21和GADD45A水平升高）。这些结果强调了SFN通过p53信号通路在胰腺癌治疗中的潜在价值。
